description: This Java class 'FlexibleMessage' wraps messages that can originate either directly from a string or from a properties file, supporting message localization and dynamic message construction within the Apache OFBiz Minilang framework.

classes.name: FlexibleMessage
classes.description: A serializable class providing a flexible way to generate messages from either direct strings or property files, supporting parameterization and localization.

methods.name: FlexibleMessage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FlexibleMessage based on the provided XML element and default property name.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message string, expanding templates and retrieving localized messages as needed using the provided class loader and method context.
